# WF6 · Tách đơn · đã duyệt

Group **WF · Thu ngân & lên đơn** · state · Next.js: **planned (U5)** (`/orders/[id]/print`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/order-review.js#refresh`
- Cashier is `operations-ui.js › cashier()`; the quick-order dialog and the order history are `order-ui.js`; the A5 review page is `order-review/index.html` + `order-review.js`; data and rules are `order-data.js`.
- `o.status === 'approved'`: the draft mark is gone, the status line reads "Đã duyệt bởi <bác sĩ>" and the print buttons are enabled (`body[data-approved=true]`).
- Inventory note: Approved: print buttons enabled, draft mark gone, signature block shows the reviewer. window.print() is a native dialog.
- Page key `cashier` is allowed for roles: owner, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"cashier\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"quick-order\"]"} → {"wait":"#catalog-order-form"} → {"click":"[data-quick-add=\"H002\"]"} → {"click":"[data-quick-add=\"H005\"]"} → {"fill":["#usage-0","Bôi lớp mỏng, sáng và tối, 14 ngày"]} → {"fill":["#usage-1","Bôi lớp mỏng, sáng và tối, 14 ngày"]} → {"clickPopup":"#quick-save"} → {"wait":"#approve"} → {"click":"#approve"} → {"wait":"body[data-approved=\"true\"]"}; it must show "Đã duyệt".

Kit components used: Button×4, Card×2; shared pieces: Notice×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.
